'''Deep black''' was a level of classified material in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. A mission assigned to a secret group of pilots to root out a suspected [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] spy was classified deep black.
